incoming.name: Romania
incoming.excerpt: In 1475, Stephen the Great of Moldavia scored a decisive victory over the Ottoman Empire at the Battle of Vaslui.

outgoing.name: Danube
outgoing.excerpt: In September 1474, the Ottoman army gathered in Sofia, and from there, Suleiman marched towards Moldavia by crossing the frozen Danube on foot..

outgoing.name: Hungary
outgoing.excerpt: On June 22, 1462, Stephen made an attempt to take the castle of Chilia from the shared Hungarian- Wallachian rulership.

outgoing.name: Pope
outgoing.excerpt: Stephen refused and in November 1474, he wrote to the Pope, warning him of further Ottoman expansion and asking for assistance.

outgoing.name: Ukraine
outgoing.excerpt: The old trade route from Caffa, Akkerman, and Chilia passed through Suceava in Moldavia and Lwow in Poland (now in Ukraine).
